chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ṣafwān, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Hishām ibn Aḥmar, from al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام, who said:

He was sitting in the mosque, and I was with him, when he heard the sound of a man being flogged at the time of the dawn prayer on an intensely cold day. He said, “What is this?” They said, “A man is being flogged.” He said, “Glory be to Allah! At this hour? No one is to be flogged in any of the prescribed punishments during the winter except in the last hour of the day, and not in the summer except at the coolest time of the day.”

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, where the Imam عليه السلام was sitting

ai.seo_question: When should hudud punishments be carried out in winter and summer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the timing of carrying out corporal hudud punishments. It indicates that such punishments should be administered with consideration for weather conditions, delaying them in winter until the last hour of the day and in summer until the coolest part of the day.
